independence_evidence: Self-published from its own Shopify store by a one-designer studio (editor/art director Nancy Heley per stockist credits); about page describes it as an independent Glasgow food magazine with a Substack newsletter (https://sandweegiesmagazine.com/pages/about).
qualifies_reason: Independent Glasgow food magazine launched in 2025 with its third print issue shipping since October 2026.
what_it_is: A Glasgow food magazine that uses one kind of sandwich per issue as a way into the city's cafes, bakeries, chefs and eating habits, with photography-led features and a strong graphic design. Issues so far cover the chicken sandwich, the breakfast roll and the fish sandwich. It is for people interested in Scottish food culture and city life rather than recipes.
